'''Bodø Station''' ({{langx|no|Bodø stasjon}}) is a [[railway station]] located in the center of the [[Bodø (town)|town of Bodø]] in [[Bodø Municipality]] in [[Nordland]] county, [[Norway]].  The station is the [[terminal station|terminus]] of the [[Nordland Line]] that was completed in 1961. The station is served by day- and [[Night trains of Norway|night trains]] to [[Trondheim]] and [[commuter train]]s to [[Rognan]], operated by [[SJ Norge]] using [[NSB Class 93|Class 93]] units.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.jernbaneverket.no/no/Jernbanen/Stasjonssok/-B-/Bodo/|title=Bodø|publisher=[[Jernbaneverket]]|language=Norwegian|accessdate=2012-03-12|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120403025228/http://www.jernbaneverket.no/no/Jernbanen/Stasjonssok/-B-/Bodo/|archive-date=2012-04-03|url-status=dead}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://www.nsb.no/stations_ac/bodoe-station-article25099-2767.html|title=Bodø Station|publisher=[[Vy|NSB]]|accessdate=2012-03-12|url-status=dead|archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20120616095411/http://www.nsb.no/stations_ac/bodoe-station-article25099-2767.html|archivedate=2012-06-16}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=http://forsk.njk.no/stdb/index.php?Stnr=4955&aut=&mod=st&sid=1883|title=Bodø stasjon|publisher=[[Norsk Jernbaneklubb]]|language=Norwegian|accessdate=2012-03-12}}</ref>

The decision to build the railway to Bodø was made in 1923, but was not completed until the 1960s due to lack of funds and [[World War II]]. [[Freight train|Freight traffic]] was permitted starting in December 1961 while the passenger section was opened on 7 June 1962 by [[Olav V of Norway|King Olav V]]. In 2010, the station building was upgraded for {{NOK|25 million}}, including a 23-room, 71-bed [[hostel]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.an.no/nyheter/article5331404.ece |title=Åpnet ny jernbanestasjon |first=Øyvind |last=Johansen |date=1 October 2010 |language=Norwegian |work=[[Avisa Nordland]] |accessdate=18 October 2010 |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20101004151034/http://www.an.no/nyheter/article5331404.ece |archivedate=4 October 2010 |url-status=dead }}</ref>
